title: 第十一章 木叶三忍二第十二章 拜师学艺
lines: 纲手三人长吁了口气，刚刚转身，却见山椒鱼仍旧静静的趴伏在地面上，三人心头一凛，顿时明会半藏仍旧生还。回头望向泥沼地中，哪里还有半藏的身影，只剩下一滩水渍。
“水分身！！”正当诧异之际，“咔嚓“，大蛇丸的脚下地面陡然裂开，一条手臂从中鱼贯而出，将大蛇丸的小腿死死扣住，用力向下拖拽。
没有时间诧异，纲手利用半藏与大蛇丸较力产生的一瞬间僵直的时间，右脚上抬，而后用力劈下。
“天守脚！”丝毫不像肉体与岩石碰撞的声音，巨大的轰鸣声响起，地面崩碎，碎石飞溅，以纲手为中心近五十米以内的地面都被震碎成蛛网状。条条裂痕交叉分错，断裂的地层将半藏挤压其中。三人急忙后撤，以品字形包围着被纲手轰击过的区域。
半藏的手臂被卡死在四散的岩石中，已被扭曲成了一个不可思议的角度，显然骨头已断裂成数节。
只是，在三人的惊诧的眼神中，伸出的手臂变成了一缕水渍流在地面上。
“又是水分身，什么时候！！”大蛇丸暗骂了一声，其余两人心思也是一般，众人脑筋飞速转动，分析着之前战斗时的细节。
大蛇丸忽感脊背一凉，刺骨寒意涌上心田，后颈处一道幽幽的声音响起：“在最开始的时候。”话音还未消散，大蛇丸感觉周围被水覆盖，精纯的水属性查克拉让他无法挣脱，水球形成，将大蛇丸困在其中，正是水牢术。
半藏的身影在大蛇丸身边出现，双手插在水球之中，维持着水牢术，让忍术不会消散。同时，邻近脚下的水渍缓缓升起，逐渐显现出人形轮廓，正是半藏。
“现在，只有两个了。”半藏将腰后的镰刀拔出，烟雨如雾，滴在在锋利的镰刃上发出清脆的撞击声，显然，他才是半藏的本体，而维持水牢术的只是他的水分身罢了。
不过，没有预料之中的那般轻松，水牢中的大蛇丸慢慢分解，成为一块块泥土，漂浮在水球之中，而本体则是在远处缓缓从地面上升起。大蛇丸确实如蛇一般的警觉，心头涌上危险时心念一动，使用了土替身躲过一劫。大蛇丸一脸严肃，警惕的观察着半藏的一举一动，眼眸深处闪过一丝骇然。
半藏心中产生了一丝惊讶，随即怒火中烧，脚下的雨渍泛起了丝丝波纹，强大的查克拉从身体各处宣泄而出。
“先下手为强！！”见到正在提取查克拉的半藏，大蛇丸和自来也双手同时结印，手指高速飞舞，交叉分错，如同蝴蝶穿花一般灵活，泛起一阵阵残影。”火遁。火龙炎弹！！”“火遁。龙火之术！！”空中的两条火龙逐渐的盘绕在一起，双龙交汇，声势浩大，周围淅沥的雨水在化为丝丝雾气，缠绕在一起的火龙向半藏袭去。
半藏凝视着咆哮的巨型龙形火焰，不慌不忙，结印在瞬间完成，“水幕帐！！”水墙升起，将半藏的四周都包裹在水壁中，毫无死角。熊熊烈火，涛涛水壁，撞击在一起散发出浓浓的雾气，将整个战场笼罩其中，能见度也不过在丈许方圆之内。
身处雾中，三人不敢轻举妄动。
“嗖嗖“，破空之声乍现，上百发手里剑从浓雾中透出，如漫天花雨将三人笼罩，没有毫厘的躲闪空间。
二人将纲手护在身后，各自掏出了苦无将苦无纷纷打落在地，“叮叮“的金铁相交的脆声不绝于耳，如珍珠落在玉盘上清脆响亮。
可恰在此时，刚刚滑过身侧的手里剑迸发出浓浓的白烟，半藏挥舞着长链勾镰从中窜将而出，直指自来也的小腹要害。自来也慌忙之中将苦无横挡，想要挡住这一击。
“一闪“，半藏沉吟一声，镰刀上附着了一层淡青色的查克拉，切割的速度陡然加快，迅捷如闪电，自来也将身子下意识的一侧。”刺啦“一声，忍者服的肋部被被划破了一道五寸来长的口子，手中抵挡的苦无已经断成了两截，切口处平润光滑，泛起丝丝冷光。
半藏已从自来也身边略过，自来也不禁长吁了口气，庆幸自己刚才的好运，只是。。。
“锁链镰刀二段击！”半藏的嘴角泛起一丝冷笑，长链舞动，本来略过自来也胸口的镰刀在空中画了一个诡异的弧线，如同飘零的秋叶不可捉摸，刀锋元转，竟来到了自来也的后颈处。
近距离的攻击让自来也反应不及，如同人遭遇生死危局时的第一反应，自来也头部一歪，将后颈要害避过，不过镰刀划过肩膀，迸发出一丝血雾，伤口处流出的鲜血略带暗色，显然镰刀上涂抹过剧毒。半藏见一击得手，转过身子准备向自来也发动二重攻击。
“大蛇丸，拖住他，我去看看自来也。”纲手交代了一声，闪身到自来也身边，将他带到了远处，左手运起了绿色的查克拉，附着在伤口处，缓缓抽出血液中的毒素。
大蛇丸此时已和半藏战在一起。大蛇丸诡异的蛇系忍术与半藏诡异的镰刀技有着异曲同工之妙，虽处于下风，但一时间半藏也无法摆脱他的纠缠。
“潜影多蛇手！！”“一闪！”刀芒闪过，群蛇均断成两截，不过大蛇丸抓住招式使用完的一丝空隙，左手再度化为群蛇袭向半藏的面门，半藏的镰刀收势不及，只能侧身躲过。
见到了意料之中的情形，大蛇丸嘴角一咧：“邪蛇腕爆！”一声闷响，群蛇猛然爆炸开来，紫黑色的血液散落在空气中，半藏的身上脸上也被血污沾染。
大蛇丸顿感轻松许多，蛇血中饱含了大量的毒液，见血封喉。
content_en:
Tsunade and the others let out a long breath, and just turned around, only to see the Sansho Fish still lying quietly on the ground. Their hearts froze, and they suddenly realized that Hanzo was still alive. Looking back at the swamp, Hanzo was nowhere to be seen, only a puddle of water was left.
"Water body!!" Just as he was surprised, "click", the ground under Orochimaru's feet suddenly cracked, and an arm came out from it, clasping Orochimaru's calf tightly and dragging it downwards.
There was no time to be surprised, Tsunade took advantage of the moment of stiffness caused by the struggle between Hanzo and Orochimaru, raised her right foot, and then slashed it down hard.
"Tenshuji!" There was no sound like the sound of flesh colliding with rocks. A huge roar sounded, the ground collapsed, gravel flew, and the ground within nearly fifty meters with Tsunade as the center was shattered into a spider web shape. The cracks are criss-crossed, and the fractured strata squeeze Hanzang into it. The three people retreated hurriedly and surrounded the area bombarded by Tsunade in a glyph formation.
Hanzo's arm was stuck in the scattered rocks and had been twisted to an incredible angle. It was obvious that the bones had been broken into several sections.
However, in the astonished eyes of the three people, the outstretched arm turned into a wisp of water and flowed on the ground.
"Water body again, when!!" Orochimaru cursed secretly, and the other two people were also thinking in general. Everyone's brains were spinning rapidly, analyzing the details of the previous battle.
Orochimaru suddenly felt a chill running down his spine, and a biting chill rushed into his heart. A faint voice sounded from the back of his neck: "At the very beginning." Before the words dissipated, Orochimaru felt that his surroundings were covered in water. The pure water attribute chakra made it impossible for him to break free. A water ball formed, trapping Orochimaru in it, which was the water prison technique.
Hanzo's figure appeared next to Orochimaru, his hands inserted into the water ball, maintaining the water prison technique so that the ninjutsu would not dissipate. At the same time, the water stains near the feet slowly rose, gradually revealing the outline of a human figure, which was Hanzo.
"Now, there are only two." Hanzo pulled out the scythe from his waist. The mist was like mist, dripping on the sharp scythe blade and making a crisp impact sound. Obviously, he was Hanzo's true body, and it was only his water body that maintained the Water Prison Technique.
However, it was not as easy as expected. Orochimaru in the water prison slowly decomposed into pieces of soil, floating in the water ball, while the main body slowly rose from the ground in the distance. Orochimaru was indeed as alert as a snake. When danger came to his mind, he used an earth substitute to escape the danger. Orochimaru had a serious face, vigilantly observing Hanzo's every move, a hint of horror flashed deep in his eyes.
Hanzo felt a little surprised in his heart, and then he became angry. The rain stains under his feet rippled, and powerful chakra was released from all parts of his body.
"It's better to strike first!!" Seeing Hanzo extracting chakra, Orochimaru and Jiraiya formed seals with their hands at the same time, their fingers flying at high speed, criss-crossing them, as flexible as a butterfly piercing a flower, creating waves of afterimages. "Fire Release. Fire Dragon Flame Bullet!!" "Fire Release. Dragon Fire Technique!!" The two fire dragons in the air gradually entwined together, and the two dragons met with great force. The surrounding raindrops turned into mist, and the entangled fire dragons attacked Hanzo.
Hanzo stared at the roaring giant dragon-shaped flames, without any fuss, the seal was completed in an instant, "Water Curtain!!" The water wall rose, wrapping Hanzo's surroundings in the water wall, leaving no blind spots. The raging fire and the billowing water wall collided together and emitted a thick fog, shrouding the entire battlefield, and the visibility was only within a few feet.
Living in the fog, the three of them did not dare to act rashly.
"Whoosh", the sound of piercing the sky suddenly appeared, and hundreds of shurikens came out from the thick fog, covering the three of them like a rain of flowers, leaving no room for dodge.
The two of them protected Tsunade behind them, each took out a kunai and knocked the kunai to the ground. The sound of "ding" of gold and iron could be heard, like pearls falling on a jade plate.
But at this moment, thick white smoke burst out from the shuriken that had just slipped by his side, and Hanzo rushed out of it waving a long chain hook sword, pointing directly at Jiraiya's lower abdomen. Jiraiya hurriedly blocked the kunai, trying to block the blow.
"Flash", Hanzo groaned, a layer of light cyan chakra attached to the scythe, the cutting speed suddenly accelerated, as fast as lightning, Jiraiya turned his subconscious side. With a "stab" sound, a five-inch-long gash was cut on the ribs of the ninja suit. The kunai in his hand to resist it had been broken into two pieces. The incision was smooth and smooth, with a slight cold light.
Hanzo had passed by Jiraiya, and Jiraiya couldn't help but let out a long breath, thankful for his good luck just now, but. . .
"Second attack of the chain sickle!" A sneer appeared at the corner of Hanzo's mouth, and the long chain danced. The sickle that originally passed over Jiraiya's chest drew a strange arc in the air, like the elusive drifting autumn leaves. The blade turned and reached the back of Jiraiya's neck.
The close range attack made Jiraiya unable to react in time. Just like a person's first reaction when encountering a life-or-death crisis, Jiraiya tilted his head and avoided the vital part of the back of his neck. However, the scythe scratched his shoulder and burst out a trace of blood mist. The blood flowing out of the wound was slightly dark, and it was obvious that the scythe had been smeared with poison. Seeing that the attack was successful, Hanzo turned around and prepared to launch a second attack at Jiraiya.
"Orochimaru, hold him, I'll go check on Jiraiya." Tsunade confessed, dodged to Jiraiya, and took him far away. She moved green chakra with her left hand, attached it to the wound, and slowly extracted the toxins from the blood.
Orochimaru was now fighting with Hanzo. Orochimaru's weird snake ninjutsu and Hanzo's weird scythe skills are similar. Although they are at a disadvantage, Hanzo can't get rid of his entanglement for a while.
"Latent Shadow Snake Hands!!" "Flash!
